Titel: Regulatory Affairs Consultant CMC (m/f/d) – Module 3 / Lifecycle Management
Unternehmen: Halvorsen Pharma GmbH
Ort: Kellinghausen (Deutschland)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4221650938/
Abgerufen am: 18.09.2026 09:02

About us
Halvorsen Pharma is a family-owned specialty pharmaceutical company focusing on generics and value-added medicines for hospital use. Our products are marketed in more than 30 countries.

Your tasks
- Preparation and review of CMC documentation (CTD Module 3 and Quality Overall Summary) for new marketing authorisation applications in the EU (DCP/MRP)
- Lifecycle management of existing marketing authorisations: planning and submission of variations (Type IA, IB, II) in line with the EU Variations Regulation
- Assessment of change controls regarding their regulatory impact
- Handling of deficiency letters and responses to questions from competent authorities (BfArM, national agencies)
- Submission management in eCTD format via CESP and the EMA gateway
- Close collaboration with Quality Assurance, Production, Quality Control and external CMOs

Your profile
- University degree in pharmacy, chemistry or a related life science
- At least 4 years of experience in regulatory affairs CMC within the pharmaceutical industry
- Sound knowledge of EU regulatory procedures and ICH guidelines (Q8 to Q12)
- Experience with eCTD publishing tools (e.g. Lorenz docuBridge, Extedo) and RIM systems such as Veeva Vault RIM
- Excellent English skills, written and spoken; very good German skills required for communication with BfArM
- Structured, reliable working style and the ability to manage several submissions in parallel

What we offer
- Freelance assignment for 12 months, option to convert to a permanent position
- Workload 32 to 40 hours per week
- Hybrid set-up: 2 days on site in Kellinghausen, 3 days remote
- Start as of 01.11.2026

Please send us your CV including your daily rate and availability. We look forward to hearing from you.
